t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : O Groups of people! Fear Allah, for there is many a man who aspires for what he does not get, many a builder of a house who does not live in it, and many a collector of that which he shall just leave behind. Possibly he may have collected it wrongfully or by demying a right. He acpuired it unlawfully and had to bear the weight of sins on account of it. Consequently, he returned (from this world) with that weight and came before Allah with sorrew and grief. Loses he both this world and (also) the hereafter; that is a los (which is) manifest. (Qur'an, 22:11)
